comment: I took Professor Morgan's Virginia Government and Politics class. Her lectures were thorough and the material was very interesting. Her professional experience in media and politics made for an extremely candid view of how things do or don't get done in Virginias Capitol. Also, the  tour of the Virginia General Assembly was a great field trip!

I took Prof. Morgan's Political Science class.  I expected that it would be challenging and push students to expand their knowledge on the subject of politics. However, the class was taught much as a high school civics course, with virtually no student input or discussion. She made blanket right wing conservative statements. I would not recommend.
